'''Apru Del''' was a floating [[City/Legends|city]] that was located in the clouds of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the city served as the headquarters and training center for the space defense division of the [[Cularin Militia]]. Following the defection of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]] from the [[Thaereian military]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] transported him to Apru Del, so that he could meet with [[Osten Dal'Nay]], one of the leaders of the Militia.
